critical_code_review_comments: Rate limits and OTP records are not isolated between test runs; test fixture manually cleans rate_limits {kind: otp_email|otp_ip|verify_ip}. Consider a dev/test cleanup endpoint or per-run IP scoping if you plan CI.

emails_outbox uses ISO-string created_at; if two emails land in the same second the 'latest' sort by created_at is ambiguous. Not user-facing but tests must count-diff before/after to avoid stale-email selection.

email provider 'send failed kind=invite status=failed' shows up in stderr when EMAIL_API_KEY is empty — the outbox still records the copy (good), but log level could be lowered for empty-key case to reduce noise.
test_credentials: Admin: vishalmanikonda@icloud.com (OTP read from emails_outbox). Fresh invite tokens are minted per test by seeding a lead + calling leads._issue_invite; token extracted from emails_outbox invite email HTML.
seed_data_creation: Created a fresh approved lead (ui_test_*@example.com) via leads._issue_invite to obtain a live invite token used by the Playwright invite-consume flow. Test suite creates ephemeral leads with TEST-style unique emails per run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_phase1_flows.py -v -o addopts=''`. The session fixture cleans rate_limits (kind in [otp_email, otp_ip, verify_ip]) and admin OTPs; if you add tests that call /api/invite/request many times, also clean 'invite_ip'. To get a live invite token for UI tests, seed a lead + call app.services.leads._issue_invite, then read emails_outbox {to,kind:'invite'} html. Frontend flow /invite?token=... -> /setup -> /today works end-to-end. All required data-testids exist.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. Two initial test-suite failures were self-inflicted (a) motor AsyncIOMotorClient reused across pytest event loops (fixed by switching db fixture to pymongo sync), and (b) OTP rate-limit and stale outbox emails causing invalid_code on re-runs (fixed by cleaning rate_limits and using a count-diff before/after request-code).
